title: Rainy Days in 19th Century Painting
content: Nineteenth-century painters loved capturing the unique effects of rainy weather and wet streets."Rainy Day in Paris" byUlpiano Checa(Spanish, 1860-1916).Ulpiano Checa(Spanish, 1860-1916) blurs the silhouettes of the buildings and carriages, and reserves his detail for the horses.Columbus Avenue, Rainy Day byChilde Hassam,1885Childe Hassam(American 1859-1935) painted Columbus Avenue in New York City. He also softens the distant buildings and he groups the scene into two large blocks of tone.
